name_input: E S P SAFETY PRIVATE LIMITEED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug esp-safety-private-limited) shows 5 visible rows out of a stated "Total Shipments 287 Records detected"; exact line: "2026-02-14 ESP SAFETY PRIVATE LIMITED MT CORP FLAME DETECTOR-IPES IRUV SS316- DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India HO CHI MINH C, Vietnam 85311090 9680237". Other visible export rows: 2025-12-12 to HO CHI MINH C, Vietnam, HS 85389000, B/L 7818859; 2025-11-20 to HO CHI MINH C, Vietnam, HS 90271000, B/L 0470716; 2025-05-07 to MOSCOW, Russia, HS 85441190, B/L 6771180. Counter: page claims 287 shipments, 5 rows actually rendered on the free view (4 outbound + 1 inbound from ESP Safety Inc, San Francisco, HS 85441190, B/L 9388132).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split was retrievable: volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge, and DuckDuckGo search was unreachable. Registered address visible on ImportKey: "B-103 MAURYA APARTMENTS 95 I.P. EXTENSION, PATARGANJ" (Delhi). No domestic supply record found or refuted — null, not public in accessible sources.
note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: outbound air-cargo consignments from Delhi Air Cargo to Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) and Moscow (Russia) between 2025-05 and 2026-02, with B/L numbers and HS codes. Declared HS set (760691; 853190; 853890; 854411) only partially matches observed codes: 853890 and 854411 appear in records, while 85311090 and 90271000 (flame/gas detectors) appear but were not declared — HS should be corrected to the factual codes; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Company also imports from related entity ESP Safety Inc (USA) and JSC Electronstandart Pribor (Russia), i.e. it is a manufacturer_trader-type operation with both inbound components and outbound finished detectors. Domestic (India) supply side remains unverified — no GST/tender evidence accessible, so recorded as unknown rather than declared. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views: null.
